title: Copper water pipes over 40 years old

mitigation.action: Plumber inspects the copper pipes and joints for pitting and green deposits and renews the tap-water pipes

known_quirks: Thin-walled copper pipes from the 1970s pit from the inside and pinhole without warning
Pipes cast into the concrete floor of a 1970s house leak unseen under the floor until the water bill rises
Green or white deposits at a joint are a leak that has already started
Soft-soldered joints from before the 1980s fail before the pipe itself
why_hint: DRAFT: The tap-water pipes are copper and over 40 years old. Copper pipes of this age pit from the inside, and pipes cast into the floor leak unseen.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: New pipes remove a hidden leak source. Tap-water pipes are the second largest leak source in Finance Finland's leak study.
